name: StructuredVolumeRenderer
definition: A reusable renderer for scalar, vector, and hybrid WebGPU volume rendering that consumes storage buffers or 3D textures, exposing facades at @luma.gl/scene/forward, /deferred, /raytrace, and /raymarch.
summary: StructuredVolumeRenderer is a reusable, graph-native WebGPU renderer for scalar, vector, and hybrid volume data that distinguishes itself through manual trilinear interpolation and fixed-step jittered ray marching.
